mostWorthwhile.text: Bringing the journeys to the empty volcanic island and hearing different songs gave the chapter a satisfying arc from arrival to change across generations.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sequence of only-offered combinations toward seasons and migration was useful progress but left little room for meaningful decisions.

surprise.text: Rocky world plus air producing axial tilt surprised me; the later explanation of seasons clarified tilt's effects, but not how air created it.

arbitrary.text: Air's role in creating both axial tilt and different songs was unclear, even allowing for mythic compression.

continue.text: I would continue to see what else the world makes on its own, although I would hope for more meaningful choices than the final run of single options.
